title: Performance Marketer
description:
**Job Title: Performance Marketer**

**Experience: 3 \- 5 Years**

**Industry: Digital Marketing Agency**

**Location: Ellisbridge, Ahmedabad**

**Job Overview:** We are hiring a performance\-focused Performance Marketer to spearhead digital initiatives that drive leads, enhance brand positioning, and deliver tangible business impact. The ideal candidate is a proactive leader with multi\-channel expertise and the ability to manage campaigns end\-to\-end with a strong focus on ROI.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies to drive lead generation and brand growth.
* Manage and optimize campaigns across SEO, SEM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and social media platforms.
* Oversee content marketing initiatives including blogs, case studies, website updates, and email campaigns.
* Monitor campaign performance, track KPIs, and continuously optimize strategies to improve ROI.
* Conduct industry research and competitor analysis to identify trends and implement new strategies.
* Manage client onboarding and ensure smooth execution of end\-to\-end digital marketing activities.
* Develop and implement monthly growth plans for clients and internal projects.
* Handle website management and coordination for website development (including WordPress and basic HTML understanding).
* Coordinate with internal teams including graphic designers, video editors, and external stakeholders such as influencers.
* Manage and optimize the use of digital marketing tools and internal agency tools.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders at all levels.
* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and deliverables efficiently.
* Manage WhatsApp API automation and execute end\-to\-end webinar operations including setup, communication, and performance tracking.
* Provide leadership and guidance to the digital marketing team (prior team handling experience is an advantage).

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing or a specialization in Digital Marketing.
* 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing (preferably in B2B industry).
* Strong knowledge of SEO, SEM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Google Analytics.
* Experience in webinar setup, e\-commerce marketing, remarketing and custom audience targeting.
* Hands\-on experience with marketing automation tools.
* Good understanding of website management (WordPress and basic HTML knowledge preferred).
* Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and team management skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, resources, and deadlines effectively.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* What is your Current CTC?
* What is your Expected CTC?
* How soon you will be able to join our team?

Experience:

* Google Ads: 2 years (Required)
* Meta Ads: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Digital Marketer
description:
**Social Media ExecutiveLocation: Iskon, Ahmedabad (On\-site)**  
**Experience: 1 to 3 Years**  
**Shift Timing: 12 PM to 9 PM**

**Note:** Experience with Meta Pixel, Events Manager, conversion tracking, and basic campaign attribution is a must.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative and results\-driven **Social Media Executive** to manage and grow our social media presence and support paid social media campaigns. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in **social media management, content creation, Meta Ads, audience engagement, and performance analytics**.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Develop and execute social media strategies aligned with business and marketing objectives.

· Manage day\-to\-day activities across platforms such as **Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and YouTube**.

· Create, curate, and publish engaging social media content, including posts, reels, stories, carousels, and videos.

· Prepare and maintain a **social media content calendar** to ensure consistent and timely publishing.

· Write compelling captions, post copy, hashtags, and other social media content.

· Plan, set up, manage, and optimise **Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram**.

· Conduct audience research and create relevant **Meta Ads audiences, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and retargeting campaigns**.

· Monitor Meta Ads performance and optimise campaigns based on **CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, conversions, ROAS, and other relevant KPIs**.

· Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, content writers, and other teams to develop social media and advertising creatives.

· Monitor social media trends, competitor activities, industry developments, and emerging content formats.

· Engage with followers, respond to comments and messages, and support community management.

· Track and analyse organic and paid social media performance using platform analytics and reporting tools.

· Prepare regular performance reports covering reach, engagement, followers, website traffic, leads, conversions, and paid campaign performance.

· Identify opportunities to improve engagement, reach, brand visibility, lead generation, and audience growth.

· Conduct **A/B testing of ad creatives, copy, audiences, placements, and campaign objectives** to improve campaign performance.

· Coordinate with the marketing and sales teams to ensure social media\-generated leads are properly tracked and followed up.

· Conduct hashtag, audience, competitor, and content research to improve organic and paid performance.

· Ensure all social media communication and advertising follows the company's brand guidelines and tone of voice.

**Required Skills**

· **1–3 years of hands\-on experience in social media management and digital marketing.**

· Strong knowledge of major social media platforms, particularly **Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn**.

· Hands\-on experience with **Meta Ads Manager** and managing Facebook/Instagram advertising campaigns.

· Good understanding of **campaign setup, targeting, retargeting, audience creation, budget allocation, bidding, ad placements, and campaign optimisation**.

· Ability to analyse Meta Ads performance using metrics such as **CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, conversion rate, and ROAS**.

· Experience with **Meta Pixel, Events Manager, conversion tracking, and basic campaign attribution** is a must.

· Strong copywriting and content\-writing abilities.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Understanding of social media analytics and key performance metrics.

· Basic knowledge of tools such as **Canva, Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, and social media scheduling platforms**.

· Ability to identify trends and convert them into relevant content ideas.

· Strong organisational and time\-management skills.

· Creative mindset with attention to detail.

· Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Bachelor's degree in **Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Mass Communication, or a related field**.

· Experience managing social media accounts for **B2B, B2C, SaaS, IT, or service\-based businesses** is a plus.

· Experience in **lead\-generation campaigns through Meta Ads** will be an advantage.

· Experience with short\-form video content, reels, and social media campaigns.

· Basic understanding of **SEO, Google Ads, and broader digital marketing** is preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

· Social media reach and impressions

· Engagement rate

· Follower/audience growth

· Content performance

· Website traffic from social channels

· Leads and conversions generated through social media

· **Meta Ads CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, conversion rate, and ROAS**

· Cost per lead/acquisition

· Community engagement and response rate

· Consistency and quality of content publishing

· Overall contribution to brand awareness and lead generation

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
